name: openlmis-not-found-page
title: Not Found Page
description: A 404 page that shows the address that was asked for, with Go Back and Back Home, ready to render inside an app shell so the navigation stays.
docs: Requires a `base-*` style in components.json (the `shadcn init` default). Legacy `new-york`/`radix-*` styles install Radix primitives, which reject the `render` prop this item uses.
